summary: crm-cleanup 0.2.0 published to the runx registry as iliasabk/crm-cleanup@sha-b96caf149e87. The graph reads the live CRM event stream (data.read_projection + data.read_events), reconciles a real earnings-call transcript, commits supported allowlisted field updates through the CRM transport (data.append_event, optimistic concurrency on the read head version), re-reads the stream, and seals takeaways, field_updates, and write_result {before, after, committed_event}. Clean registry install, 5/5 harness cases on source and on the installed package, live dogfood executed 3 updates and committed crm.field_updates event crm_records:pipeline-q3:2; a second live no-op dogfood committed nothing.
